name: team_planning_undo_change
description: Undo a change, pin or clear in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, so the scenario resolves as if it had not been made. Give event_id, as team_planning_history lists it, or leave it out to undo your own latest change in the scenario that can still be undone. Refused when a later change to the same subject and facet replaced it (the refusal names that change: undo it first), when it is already undone, or unless the caller is an editor. In a plan scoped to chosen units, an undo is refused when the change it brings back is about someone, a unit or a position the plan no longer covers, unless it places them in. Refused, too, when it brings back a last day outside the dates of the step they leave in, or a unit of a type removed since. A date edit of a step (a dates entry) is undone too, bringing back the step's previous dates under the same checks as a new date edit: refused when a later date edit of the step replaced it, when the step forked after it closed its dates (a closing is never undone: set the dates instead), or when a later step would end before it starts, naming that step. Without the see-pay right, a change to a budget line that carries an amount is refused, and left out when event_id is. Nothing is deleted: the history keeps it, marked undone.
